q: Why do songs get removed from GTA games?
a: Licensed songs are usually cleared for a fixed term, and both the composition and the recording need permission. When those licenses expire, Rockstar has patched the songs out of the versions it still sells, as with GTA IV in April 2018 after what were reported as 10-year licenses.

q: What songs were removed from GTA IV in 2018?
a: An April 26, 2018 update removed songs across 10 stations, with Vladivostok FM losing 15 and gaining 11 replacements. Game Informer counted 43 removals, while Destructoid listed 51 by including Episodes from Liberty City tracks and an unused file.

q: Why is Billie Jean not in GTA Vice City anymore?
a: Vice City was pulled from PC stores in November 2012 over what Rockstar called music licensing issues, and returned in December 2012 without both of its Michael Jackson songs. They are also missing from the 2021 Definitive Edition.

q: How many songs were removed from GTA San Andreas?
a: A November 2014 Steam update removed 17 songs so the PC version matched the mobile version. The 2021 Definitive Edition launched with 18 San Andreas songs missing by VGC's count, three of which Rockstar's updated list then reinstated.

q: Was The Time Is Now by Moloko removed from GTA 5?
a: Yes, on PC: a hotfix for GTA V Enhanced around September 15, 2026 removed it from Non-Stop-Pop FM. Rockstar made no statement, and an expired license is the press's likely explanation.

q: How much does Rockstar pay to put a song in GTA?
a: Rockstar does not publish its fees. Heaven 17's Martyn Ware said in 2024 he was offered $7,500 as a perpetual buyout for a GTA VI song and declined; that is his account only.

q: How many copies has GTA 5 sold?
a: Take-Two said in November 2026 that GTA V had sold nearly 235 million units, an official sold-in figure for the quarter to September 30, 2026. That was up from over 230 million in August 2026.

q: Can I still play GTA IV with the original soundtrack?
a: In 2018, players on PC, PS3 and Xbox 360 could keep the original songs by not installing the April 26 update, and per the GTA wiki console disc copies were unaffected. Updated digital copies carry the reduced soundtrack.
